body: Schedule analysis shows easyJet, Ryanair and Wizz Air have collectively cut 25 routes from London recently. They all operated sometime between January and October 2026 but have no flights scheduled thereafter, even through 2027, and 13 ended in September or October. In 2026, OAG data shows the trio operates nearly one in two short-haul departures from London (47%), with 200,295 departures available in the year — the first year above 200,000 — averaging 549 daily outbound flights.

easyJet has ended five routes: Luton–Athens and Southend–Grenoble in March, Gatwick–Newquay in August, and Luton–Almeria and Luton–Izmir in October. The carrier reintroduced Gatwick–Newquay in June 2026, but flights ended two months later; the 188-nautical-mile route was served three times a week, and Gatwick–Newquay now has no flights at all.

Ryanair has pulled six routes, most from Stansted: Stansted–Rodez in August, and Luton–Treviso, Luton–Rzeszów, Stansted–Bodrum, Stansted–Dalaman and Stansted–Salerno in October. The cuts include both Bodrum and Dalaman in Turkey, as the airline has entirely pulled out of the country; at Salerno, Ryanair has ended all international flights but continues one domestic route.

Wizz Air has ended 14 routes — more than the other two carriers combined — including Gatwick–Marrakech, Gatwick–Warsaw Chopin, Gatwick–Wrocław, Luton–Amman, Luton–Kraków and Luton–Vienna in March, Gatwick–Jeddah and Gatwick–Medina in July, and Gatwick–Faro, Gatwick–Istanbul Airport, Gatwick–Santorini, Luton–Corfu, Luton–Mykonos and Luton–Zakynthos in October. Its Jeddah and Medina services were flown daily on the Airbus A321XLR with a maximum block time of nearly seven hours.
en.summary: easyJet, Ryanair and Wizz Air have collectively cut 25 routes from London, with no flights scheduled on any of them after 2026; Wizz Air accounts for 14 of the cuts, Ryanair six and easyJet five.
en.title: easyJet, Ryanair & Wizz Air Cancel 25 Routes From London

body: 航班時刻表分析顯示，易捷、瑞安與維茲航空近期共取消25條倫敦航線。這些航線在2026年1月至10月間都曾營運，但此後皆無航班排定，2027年也沒有；其中13條在9月或10月結束。OAG數據顯示，三家業者2026年合計佔倫敦短程航班近半（47%），全年倫敦出發航班200295班，首次突破20萬班，平均每天549班出境航班。
易捷航空取消5條航線：3月結束盧頓—雅典與紹森德—格勒諾布爾，8月結束蓋特威克—紐基，10月結束盧頓—阿爾梅里亞與盧頓—伊茲密爾。其中蓋特威克—紐基航線2026年6月才恢復營運，兩個月後再度停飛；該航線188海里，每週3班，目前蓋特威克—紐基已完全沒有航班。
瑞安航空取消6條航線，多數自史坦斯特機場出發：8月結束史坦斯特—羅德茲，10月結束盧頓—特維索（航班移至威尼斯马波羅機場）、盧頓—熱輪夫、史坦斯特—博德魯姆、史坦斯特—達拉曼與史坦斯特—薩萊諾。瑞安已完全退出土耳其市場；在薩萊諾，瑞安結束所有國際航班，但仍保留一條國內航線。
維茲航空取消14條航線，多於另外兩家業者合計：3月結束蓋特威克—馬拉喀什、蓋特威克—華沙蕭邦、蓋特威克—弗羅茲瓦夫、盧頓—安曼、盧頓—克拉科夫與盧頓—維也納，7月結束蓋特威克—吉達與蓋特威克—麥地那，10月結束蓋特威克—法魯、蓋特威克—伊斯坦堡機場、蓋特威克—聖托里尼、盧頓—科尔、盧頓—米科諾斯與盧頓—扎金索斯。吉達與麥地那航線以空中巴士A321XLR每日執飛，最長飛行時間近7小時。
zh.summary: 易捷、瑞安與維茲航空近期共取消25條倫敦航線，三家業者2026年合計佔倫敦短程航班近半；其中維茲航空取消14條，瑞安6條，易捷5條，13條在9月或10月結束。
zh.title: 易捷、瑞安與維茲航空取消25條倫敦航線
